title: Advancing the 2-Optimality Motif Finding problem: new benchmarks and efficient algorithms
description: Implementation of exact and heuristic algorithms for the 2-Optimality Motif Finding (2OMF) problem: finding a consensus sequence that minimizes the sum of squared Hamming distances to all input sequences. Includes Simulated Annealing, Hybrid Genetic Algorithm (HG2), and Gurobi-based exact optimization.
